title: Exact-Z/Q Strassen Spectral Interpolation, Flattening-Rank Interval Bounds, and Border-Rank Separation Certificates for the Asymptotic Spectrum of Tensors
abstract: Motivated by Vrana and Zuiddam's proof (arXiv:2611.34664v1, Nov. 2026) that Strassen's asymptotic spectrum Delta(T_k) of complex order-k tensors (k >= 3) is path-connected, we construct a machine-checked, zero-float verification and witness suite (TENSOR-SPECTRUM-CONN-CERT-1.0) backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited exact-Z/Q Python verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 62 adversarial tests. We prove and certify: (i) exact 3-mode flattening ranks and Strassen semiring homomorphism laws (Kronecker multiplicativity and direct-sum additivity) across <a,b,c>, W_3, and Coppersmith-Winograd CW_q tensors; (ii) root-free integer-power spectral interval sandwiches m^D <= r_1^{n_1} r_2^{n_2} r_3^{n_3} <= M^D, strict simplex-edge monotonicity, and balanced volume-square identities zeta_{(1/3,1/3,1/3)}(<a,b,c>)^3 = (abc)^2; (iii) an exhaustive 8-entry Z[eps] border-rank-2 witness for W_3 and root-free cube separation (2^{h(1/3)})^3 = 27/4 < 8 = rk_j(W_3)^3 amplified as 27^k < 32^k; and (iv) exact graph asymptotic spectrum sandwiches for C_5 (4 < 5 < 25/4) and C_7 via a root-free Chebyshev bracket on 8t^3 - 4t^2 - 4t + 1 certifying vartheta(C_7) in (63/19, 637/191) subset (3, 7/2).
